_comment_xml_routes: DYNAMIC sitemap/feed/llms paths (e.g. /sitemap.xml, /feed.xml, /llms.txt) are intentionally NOT in exclude - they MUST flow through _worker.js so it can proxy them to the backend (see SEO_PASSTHROUGH_RE). Build-time generated static sitemaps (sitemap-index.xml, sitemap-static.xml, sitemap-subjects.xml, sitemap-chapters.xml) ARE correctly excluded below because they exist as real files produced by generate-static-data.mjs and do not need the worker proxy.
_comment_ads_txt: ads.txt MUST be in exclude — it is a plain-text static file served directly from the CDN. Without this, the worker intercepts it, falls back to PAGES_ORIGIN, which re-enters the same Pages deployment creating an infinite-proxy loop that always returns the SPA HTML instead of the AdSense verification line.
_comment_static_generated: Sitemaps and /static/* are build-time generated files that bypass the worker and are served directly from the CDN. The generate-static-data.mjs script produces these during the build step.
